تحتوشين (form VIII)
# تَحْتَوِشِينَ (taḥtawišīna) /taħ.ta.wi.ʃiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
# تُحْتَوَشِينَ (tuḥtawašīna) /tuħ.ta.wa.ʃiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
